description: This Java class handles Wi-Fi state changes in an Android application, managing Wi-Fi connectivity events, retrieving network information, and broadcasting updates. It includes background processing for network details and interacts with various system services and app components.

classes.name: WifiStateChangeService
classes.description: Handles Wi-Fi state changes, manages network info retrieval, and broadcasts updates. Runs background threads for network details and interacts with system services.

classes.name: WifiInfoThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread to perform background Wi-Fi network information retrieval and setup.

methods.name: registerReceiver
methods.description: Registers a receiver for Wi-Fi state change broadcasts.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Enqueues work to handle Wi-Fi state changes based on an intent.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the main background task to process Wi-Fi state and initiate info retrieval.

methods.name: setSsid
methods.description: Sets the current SSID and BSSID based on Wi-Fi connection info or hotspot status.

methods.name: setIpInfoFromNetworkInterface
methods.description: Scans network interfaces to determine IP address and subnet info.

methods.name: formatIpAddress
methods.description: Formats an integer IP address into dotted decimal string.

methods.name: printWifiState
methods.description: Returns a string representation of Wi-Fi state integer.
